The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Operate reveal payments, subscriptions, invoices, refunds and disputes safely, reconcile provider events and maintain complete transaction evidence. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Every payment state is accurate, reconcilable and recoverable without exposing secrets or moving funds outside authority. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Every payment state is accurate, reconcilable and recoverable without exposing secrets or moving funds outside authority.

title: Failed Payments — how the department uses it
content: When work involves failed payments, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Every payment state is accurate, reconcilable and recoverable without exposing secrets or moving funds outside authority.

title: Failed Payments — controls and boundaries
content: For failed payments, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Every payment state is accurate, reconcilable and recoverable without exposing secrets or moving funds outside authority.

title: Failed Payments — evidence and live-data requirements
content: The department should prove work on failed payments through the authoritative record for the entity, relevant documents, event history, approvals and outcome metrics.
